reviewer: hud_goal_review, independent of implementation and overall visual-review-02.json
verdict: PASS for the four identified actual-native tablet exports; one stale folder caption needs correction.
scope: Direct visual comparison of each retained JPEG with its exact indexed raw PNG and the approved concept's middle Play screen. No App/test edits, builds or controller operations.

source.identityEvidence: captures-02.json and source-02-final.json; identity was not inferred from screenshot appearance.
source.device: Actual native iPad Pro 13-inch M5 simulator, iOS 27.0, AX5, indexed actual Settings Calm context

reference: docs/design/interface/observatory-game-ui-concept-2026-10-19.png, middle Play panel; concept direction only

integrity.method: Recomputed SHA-256 with Python hashlib; independently read raw/export pixel dimensions with sips. Opened all eight images for direct inspection.
integrity.dimensions: All eight files are 2064 x 2752 pixels; retained files are JPEG and raw files are PNG.
integrity.encoding: Index declares JPEG80, no retouch/crop. This review verifies hashes, full dimensions and visible correspondence; it does not independently reconstruct encoder settings.

pairs.observedState: Complete 0 / 150,000, unselected forecast destinations 6, 1, 2, 4, 5, and ordinary opening stars.
Same visible opening and complete 0 / 150,000; first forecast destination 6 is underlined and the corresponding board column has a distinct dashed outline.
Complete 15,000 / 150,000; forecast underline and board-column outline retired. Spark's visible text identifies a 2-clear chain and +15,000 starlight.
Complete 0 / 150,000 and two-line Full Board · clears refill and cascade label; all 49 opening pieces visible, with no shower forecast or column focus.

visualFindings: All score and objective digits, commas and slashes are complete. The small amber symbol sits beside the earned digits' visual center in both 0 and 15,000 states; it does not displace or overlap the target.

Exact serif score figures remain visually distinct from the supporting sans-serif forecast and mode text. All five forecast numbers and accompanying family glyphs remain separated and legible; the help glyph is distinct.

The continuous painted scene and central star field retain the middle Play reference's hierarchy. AX text protection is more prominent than in the concept, but stays above the playable stars; the fully populated Full Board remains the dominant central object.
No export introduces a visible missing stroke, clipped digit, lost selection dash or changed composition relative to its raw PNG. Minor JPEG texture softening does not obscure essential HUD ink.

captionReview.index: The four source/runtime/device/state captions agree with the inspected states. The Full Board caption explicitly excludes the later 42,000-point refill; this review makes no visual claim for it.
captionReview.documentationFinding: goal-02-captures/README.md still says actual phone/tablet journey captures remain pending. Its owner should update that stale sentence when integrating the completed capture index.

limits: Four static AX5 Calm tablet states only. This export verdict does not establish normal-motion animation, actual VoiceOver, physical-device quality or overall goal acceptance.

The images depict 0 and 15,000 toward 150,000. Six-figure earned totals, a 220,000 target, terminal results and the later 42,000-point Full Board refill require their separate mechanical or visual evidence.

The earned and Full Board captures show the start of a lower guide viewport with further content outside the image. They do not prove the complete guide is simultaneously visible or that its end was reached.
Source history and earned-event provenance remain bound to the indexed native run; a still image alone does not prove the input sequence or save/clock behavior.
